willAsk: This sale will ask the other phone for a nearby check.
soundUltrasound: A short high-pitched sound will play.
requiredNotSeen: Not heard nearby. Payment is final.
meaning: This phone played a short sound and the other phone answered it, within a few seconds of the payment. It does not show how far apart the phones were, or that nobody passed the sound along. The payment is final either way.

settings.title: Nearby check
settings.footnote: A short high-pitched sound some people can hear. Nothing is recorded.

reviewAsksMore: The receiver will ask for a nearby check after you pay. This uses the microphone and records nothing.
